sourceFiles.claim: Agent resume, snapshot RequestContext persistence/merge, requestContextSchema validation-result use, dynamic resolver, and resumed-tool ordering
exact locked schema-compat normalization of a plain Standard Schema without JSON Schema support

snapshotPersistenceObservation: The agentic-loop workflow persists requestContext.toJSON(). On direct-Agent resume, Agent.resumeGenerate resolves defaults/model and Agent.#execute resolves model/instructions/tool shaping from the fresh caller RequestContext before workflow resume. WorkflowRun._resume then backfills every snapshot key missing from that fresh RequestContext and passes the merged RequestContext to the execution engine and resumed tool. Agent requestContextSchema validation only checks validation.issues and discards validation.value, and resumeGenerate does not invoke that validation after snapshot restoration. The plan's plain Standard Schema candidate is normalized as vendor=json-schema and its validate result preserves evilStaleAuthority rather than producing the proposed closed projection.
